objective: Establish the installed and available HolyAgent versions, update repository dependencies through the documented updater and caret formats, perform any required migration, and validate the result.
requirements: Explain whether a later HolyAgent version is available and distinguish the user-level Pi installation from the repository checkout.
Update dependencies in this repository only through mise run deps:update, preserving the documented ^X.0.0, ^0.X.0 and ^0.0.X caret-range formats at their line boundaries.
Perform HolyAgent state migration if needed, without losing existing Intents, Assignments or user configuration.
Keep the main checkout on main and perform branch work in a separate git worktree.
Use kimi-coding/kimi-for-coding for delegated Pi runs.
Validate and independently review the dependency update before completion.
